description: This file defines constants and utility methods related to device connection operations within the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes string constants for field names, endpoint identifiers, event bus addresses, and an enumeration of device connection actions with methods for mapping subjects to enum values and validation.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionConstants
classes.description: A final class containing constants and utility methods used throughout the Device Connection API, extending RequestResponseApiConstants. It defines string constants for field names, endpoint names, and event bus addresses, as well as an enum for device connection actions with associated methods.

methods.name: DeviceConnectionAction.getSubject
methods.description: Returns the AMQP message subject associated with this device connection action.

methods.name: DeviceConnectionAction.from
methods.description: Constructs a DeviceConnectionAction enum value from a given subject string, returning UNKNOWN if no matching action is found.

methods.name: DeviceConnectionAction.isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given subject string corresponds to a valid device connection action.
